# Clear Calculators / Calculadoras Claras

Free bilingual calculation tools. Every page shows its formula, assumptions and limitations. Inputs are processed locally in the browser with no account and no values sent to a server.

English home: https://mercadosclaro-eng.github.io/calculadoras-claras/en/
Spanish home: https://mercadosclaro-eng.github.io/calculadoras-claras/

## English tools

- Mortgage payment: /en/mortgage-calculator.html
- Auto loan payment and total cost: /en/auto-loan-calculator.html
- General loan payment, extra payments and interest saved: /en/loan-calculator.html
- Rent vs buy wealth comparison: /en/rent-vs-buy-calculator.html
- Compound interest and regular contributions: /en/compound-interest-calculator.html
- Net salary using user-supplied rates: /en/net-salary-calculator.html
- Percentages, discounts and tax: /en/percentage-calculator.html

## Herramientas en español

- Cuota de hipoteca: /hipoteca.html
- Préstamo de coche y coste total: /prestamo-coche.html
- Préstamo general, pagos extra e intereses ahorrados: /prestamo.html
- Comprar o alquilar: /comprar-o-alquilar.html
- Interés compuesto y aportaciones: /interes-compuesto.html
- Sueldo neto usando tasas del usuario: /sueldo-neto.html
- Porcentajes, descuentos e IVA: /porcentajes.html

Results are transparent estimates, not financial, tax, medical or lending advice.
